bio: Welcome to Harvard! I grew up in San Francisco, with many summers spent in Ireland. After graduating from Santa Clara University with degrees in finance and political science, I spent a couple years investigating fraud and corruption within an accounting firm’s forensic department. I then attended Harvard Divinity School, where I studied corporate ethics, negotiations, and religious literacy. A deep interest in corporate accountability and conflict resolution brought me to law school, where I continue to study these ideas. Outside of school, I love checking out great spots around Boston (highly recommend the Arnold Arboretum) and losing years off my life supporting the 49ers. I’m excited to get to know each of you—please don’t hesitate to reach out if I can support you in any way! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Residential Life Proctors Role Residential Proctors
